name: Floodlight
description: The leading open source Java-based OpenFlow controller, supported by a community of developers including engineers from Big Switch Networks. Enterprise-grade with REST API and web GUI.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Community Docker image pierrecdn/floodlight available. Floodlight WEB GUI available at http://[container-ip]:8080/ui/pages/index.html when running as Docker container.

eval_notes: Mature SDN controller with good REST API and web GUI. Used as the base for OpenKilda. Docker images available from community. Good for testing OpenFlow-based scenarios.
